mapper.select: SELECT user_id, name, tone, avatar_media_id, version, created_at, updated_at FROM agent_profiles WHERE user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1
SELECT user_id, name, tone, avatar_media_id, version, created_at, updated_at FROM agent_profiles WHERE user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_profiles (user_id, name, tone, avatar_media_id, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{name}, #{tone}, #{avatarMediaId}, #{version}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE user_id = user_id
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_profiles SET name=#{name}, tone=#{tone}, avatar_media_id=#{avatarMediaId}, version=#{version}, updated_at=#{updatedAt} WHERE user_id=#{userId}
